{{Quote|They must have changed their family name, falsified records. The unit commander went to visit them, not long after he'd sent them the official notification of Kissek's death. The story he was going to give her, supporting the one in the notification, was that he died in battle&hellip;but Kissek's wife had already heard the truth from someone. Accused the Tierfon Yellow Aces not only of killing her husband but of ruining the family name. Maybe she tried to fix things by changing their name and moving away.|Wes Janson about Kell Tainer's mother|<ref name="WS" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] and the [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] of [[Kissek Doran]], a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Sometime during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|civil war]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Doran joined the Alliance and was assigned to the [[Tierfon Yellow Aces/Legends|Tierfon Yellow Aces]], a [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber|Y-wing]] training [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]]. When Doran [[Death/Legends|died]] during a mission against the Empire, his wife learned the truth from somebody that he died at the hands of [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]], his squadron mate. She accused the Yellow Aces of killing her husband and destroying their family name. She would later changed their name into Tainer and move from the Alderaan to [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]], taking her son [[Kell Tainer]] with her.<ref name="WS" />
